title: Quick Play Radio Station – Light Mood Rebuild

requirements.text: Implement a Quick Play feature that automatically starts playing the first available or last-played radio station as soon as the app loads, without requiring the user to manually select a station first.
acceptanceCriteria: On app load, playback begins automatically for a default or previously played station
No manual station selection is required before audio starts
A visual indicator shows which station is auto-playing

requirements.text: Redesign the entire app UI with a very light, airy mood: use a soft white or pale pastel color palette, clean minimal typography, gentle spacing, and subtle soft-shadow cards. Replace the current dark space/star theme with a bright, calm, cheerful aesthetic throughout all components (Header, TopToolbar, AudioPlayer, RadioPlaybackDisplay, SearchOverlay, UserDashboard, Footer, LoadingScreen).
acceptanceCriteria: Background is white, off-white, or very light pastel — no dark backgrounds
All major UI components reflect the light theme consistently
The dark space/starfield (SpaceScene, BlinkingStars) is removed or replaced with a light background
Buttons, cards, and overlays use soft shadows and rounded corners with light fills
Loading screen matches the light mood

requirements.text: Update the Tailwind configuration and global CSS (index.css) to define a light theme token set (background, surface, text, accent, border colors) and apply it consistently across all components.
acceptanceCriteria: tailwind.config.js defines a light theme color palette
index.css sets light background and text defaults
No hardcoded dark color classes remain in component files

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing radio station data fetching and caching logic in useQueries.ts
Keep backend/main.mo unchanged unless data model changes are required
nonGoals: Adding new radio stations or changing station data sources
Modifying backend access control or user profile logic
Changing PWA manifest or service worker caching strategy

required: Soft pastel radio wave illustration with gentle circular ripples in warm white and light coral tones, used as a hero background (radio-hero-light.dim_1200x600.png)
